brief:
Jerusalem's electricity authority announced it will cut power across multiple districts of Jerusalem on Wednesday, October 14, from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., the Ma'an news agency reported. The company said the outage was necessary and apologized for the disruption.

The blackout will affect the full area of Dahiyat al-Salam district and parts of other neighborhoods in Jerusalem governorate, according to the utility's statement.
